  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { SelectOptionItem } from "./select.shared";

  export type SelectProps = {
    value?: string;

    disabled?: boolean;
    options?: SelectOptionItem[];
    class?: string;
    children?: Snippet;
    [key: string]: unknown;

<script lang="ts">
  import { selectClasses } from "./select.shared";
  import { eqStr, safeRest, syncValue } from "../../utils/expr";

  let {
    value,
    multiple,
    required,
    disabled,
    options,
    class: className,
    children,
    ...rawRest
  }: SelectProps = $props();

  const rest = $derived(safeRest(rawRest, { blank: ["id", "name", "aria-invalid", "aria-describedby"] }));
  const cls = $derived(selectClasses({ className }));
</script>

<select {...(cls ? { class: cls } : {})} multiple={multiple || undefined} required={required || undefined} disabled={disabled || undefined} use:syncValue={value} {...rest}>
  {#each options ?? [] as item}
    <option value={(item.value) ?? ""} selected={eqStr(item.value, value) || undefined} disabled={item.disabled || undefined}>{item.label}</option>
  {/each}
  {@render children?.()}
</select>
